name: Mavacamten

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm

similar.name: Mebanazine
problems: Pulled from the market in United Kingdom, first in 1975 — for liver harm

summary: In the United States, Mavacamten carries a boxed warning, which is a serious safety alert, for harm to the heart [3]. Based on a small computer program rather than tests in people, it received a medium risk score of 57 for the liver and a low risk score of 30 for the heart [M]. Additionally, a similar drug named Mebanazine was taken off the market in the United Kingdom due to liver damage [4]. In human testing, one trial of Mavacamten was stopped early because it did not work well enough in the short term, and another was ended after the sponsor reviewed its program priorities [6][7].
